name: Gadget Blaster
summary:
The goal is simple, get your ball from start to finish without letting it explode or fall into the void!  Numerous obstacles stand in your way, so use your hand-held plasma blaster to energize a variety of innovative gadgets, each carefully designed to help you solve 80 physics-based puzzles.
